status: definitions frozen before this run; all historical holdouts already exposed

hypotheses.divergence: Existing agent_analysis.has_rsi_divergence, two trailing windows of 5 closes; RSI14 rolling arithmetic implementation unchanged; evidence component, not full reversal detector
hypotheses.oversold: Existing documented lead: RSI14 < 30 and close < EMA50; raw state, no RR gate
hypotheses.pullback: Existing EMA branch: EMA20 > EMA50, close > EMA50, low <= EMA20, close > open and close > EMA20

inference: 27 overall comparisons: Holm across all hypotheses/timeframes/horizons; phase breakdown descriptive only
baseline: all eligible next-open observations in same segment, phase and EMA20>EMA50 regime; includes event observations; descriptive association, not causal treatment effect
deduplication: greedy nonoverlapping forward windows per hypothesis/timeframe/horizon; exclude incomplete horizons and windows crossing phase labels
bootstrap: resample calendar-week clusters shared across segments and phase boundaries; centered null, one-sided excess-mean test; 999 resamples, seed 99; at least 10 clusters and 30 events to flag a statistical lead; approximate dependence control, not a new OOS
execution: reference next open to close of H-th subsequent bar; MFE/MAE over that same window; no orders, stops, targets, sizing or portfolio simulation
economic_status: gross predictive event study only; no economic validation or paper admission
